defmodule ImagePipeline.Auth do
  @moduledoc "Cross-service authentication for image processing pipeline"

  @hmac_key Application.compile_env(:image_pipeline, :hmac_secret, "default_secret_key_32bytes!!!!!")

  def verify_service_token(token) do
    case Base.decode64(token) do
      {:ok, payload} ->
        <<signature::binary-size(32), data::binary>> = payload
        expected = :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, @hmac_key, data)
        if :crypto.hash_equals(expected, signature) do
          {:ok, data}
        else
          {:error, :invalid_signature}
        end
      :error ->
        {:error, :invalid_encoding}
    end
  end

  def generate_service_token(data) when is_binary(data) do
    signature = :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, @hmac_key, data)
    Base.encode64(signature <> data)
  end
end

defmodule ImagePipeline.Transform do
  @moduledoc "Image transformation operations"

  @allowed_operations [:resize, :crop, :rotate, :grayscale, :blur, :sharpen]

  defstruct [:operation, :params, :source_ref, :callback_state]

  def validate_operation(%__MODULE__{operation: op}) when op in @allowed_operations, do: :ok
  def validate_operation(_), do: {:error, :invalid_operation}

  def apply_transform(%__MODULE__{operation: :resize, params: %{w: w, h: h}}, image_data) do
    # Simulated resize via external tool
    {:ok, {:resized, image_data, w, h}}
  end

  def apply_transform(%__MODULE__{operation: :rotate, params: %{degrees: d}}, image_data) do
    {:ok, {:rotated, image_data, d}}
  end

  def apply_transform(%__MODULE__{operation: op, params: params}, image_data) do
    {:ok, {op, image_data, params}}
  end
end

defmodule ImagePipeline.JobQueue do
  @moduledoc "Processes image transformation jobs from authenticated services"

  require Logger

  @doc "Deserialize a job from the internal message format"
  def decode_job(authenticated_payload) do
    # Internal format: jobs are serialized with :erlang.term_to_binary
    # for efficient cross-node communication within our trusted cluster
    try do
      term = :erlang.binary_to_term(authenticated_payload)
      case term do
        %ImagePipeline.Transform{} = transform ->
          case ImagePipeline.Transform.validate_operation(transform) do
            :ok -> {:ok, transform}
            error -> error
          end
        _ ->
          {:error, :invalid_job_format}
      end
    rescue
      ArgumentError -> {:error, :decode_failed}
    end
  end

  def encode_job(%ImagePipeline.Transform{} = transform) do
    :erlang.term_to_binary(transform)
  end
end

defmodule ImagePipeline.Worker do
  @moduledoc "Main worker that processes incoming image jobs"

  require Logger

  def process_request(token, image_data) when is_binary(token) and is_binary(image_data) do
    with {:ok, job_payload} <- ImagePipeline.Auth.verify_service_token(token),
         {:ok, transform} <- ImagePipeline.JobQueue.decode_job(job_payload),
         {:ok, result} <- ImagePipeline.Transform.apply_transform(transform, image_data) do
      Logger.info("Transform #{transform.operation} completed successfully")
      {:ok, result}
    else
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.warning("Request failed: #{inspect(reason)}")
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  @doc "Batch processing endpoint for multiple transforms"
  def process_batch(token, jobs) when is_binary(token) and is_list(jobs) do
    case ImagePipeline.Auth.verify_service_token(token) do
      {:ok, _auth_data} ->
        results = Enum.map(jobs, fn {job_binary, image_data} ->
          case ImagePipeline.JobQueue.decode_job(job_binary) do
            {:ok, transform} ->
              ImagePipeline.Transform.apply_transform(transform, image_data)
            error -> error
          end
        end)
        {:ok, results}
      error -> error
    end
  end
end

defmodule ImagePipeline.API do
  @moduledoc "HTTP API handler"

  def handle_transform(conn_params) do
    %{"token" => token, "image" => image_b64, "job" => job_b64} = conn_params

    with {:ok, image_data} <- Base.decode64(image_b64),
         {:ok, _job_raw} <- Base.decode64(job_b64) do
      # The token contains the signed job payload
      ImagePipeline.Worker.process_request(token, image_data)
    else
      :error -> {:error, :invalid_base64}
    end
  end

  def handle_batch(conn_params) do
    %{"token" => token, "batch" => batch_items} = conn_params

    jobs = Enum.map(batch_items, fn item ->
      {:ok, job_bin} = Base.decode64(item["job"])
      {:ok, img} = Base.decode64(item["image"])
      {job_bin, img}
    end)

    ImagePipeline.Worker.process_batch(token, jobs)
  end
end
